question: How many of the single bond type molecules are non-carcinogenic?
evidence: label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic; single bond refers to bond_type = '-';
clarification: Count every row, including repeated molecule_id values.
gold: SELECT COUNT(T2.molecule_id) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '-' AND T1.bond_type = '-'
gold0: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '-' AND T1.bond_type = '-'

d.request: How many rows have `bond_type = '-'` and `label = '-'`, counting rows with repeated `molecule_id` values separately?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond AS b JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

b.request: Count bond rows with `bond_type = '-'` whose molecule has `label = '-'`, including multiple rows for the same `molecule_id`
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond AS b JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-'
